method.baseline: Source tools/src/editor from baseline commit plus the same current compiled dist JavaScript as current. This isolates packaging policy, not a release-to-release engine benchmark.
method.current: Current working-tree tools/src/editor plus a copied current dist snapshot.
method.timing: In-process performance.now around the awaited packageGame/packageStudio call; imports, fixture copying, output inventory, hashing and gzip measurements excluded. Each variant/round starts a fresh Node process and writes new output directories.
method.cache: No cache flush or warmup samples; normal OS file cache applies equally. All measured samples retained. Small sample is directional, not statistically conclusive.
method.gzip: Sum of gzipSync(default options) lengths per emitted lib JavaScript file; this is an artifact estimate, not measured network transfer.

limitations: Only three same-machine samples; normal background load and OS caches can affect elapsed time.
Baseline intentionally uses current compiled engine bytes; the comparison measures package selection and output strategy only.
No sample was omitted and no repeat run was used to improve the verdict.

runtimeBundleComparison.method: Preserved actual 1.2.1 clean packages vs 1.2.2 packages; same campus project; sum of raw/gzip lib JS, no network or latency claim
